generationPolicy.batchRule: generate coherent families after component slots and dimensions are implemented
generationPolicy.stateVariantRule: default and selected variants share one alpha silhouette and optical box; selected changes only tone and inner glow
generationPolicy.factualMediaRule: never generate a specific article, event, item, class, source, or official image as runtime fact

slots.format: transparent PNG 9-slice or CSS-compatible edge atlas
slots.visualRole: dark metal frame with muted brass inner highlight and small cut corners
slots.currentFallback: single CSS fallback outline only when the raster frame is unavailable

slots.visualRole: neutral compass/shield medallion with blue gem
slots.currentFallback: CSS medallion and utility compass glyph

slots.visualRole: dark non-factual editorial material that supports overlaid copy
slots.currentFallback: neutral CSS editorial material without a factual or decorative media glyph

slots.visualRole: neutral thumbnail material distinct from the hero fallback
slots.currentFallback: neutral CSS thumbnail material without a factual or decorative media glyph

slots.visualRole: six category medallions with one shared silhouette and stroke family
small evidence marker; never a large decorative badge
slots.visibilityRule: render only with a real source or explicit fallback state

slots.visualRole: header favorite action with a clear star silhouette and no built-in container
vertical saved-item bookmark with a bottom notch and no built-in container

slicingRequirements: all raster outputs retain source master and deterministic slice metadata
1x and 2x runtime sizes are generated from the same master
transparent padding is measured and excluded from layout bounds
icons share optical box, baseline, stroke weight, active treatment, and naming
asset manifest records hash, dimensions, bytes, owner, slot, variant, source class, and review status
